finding_dispositions.evidence: Runner authority remained caller-obtainable and accepted caller-forged PASS state; the completion issuer remained callable without a Gate assessment.
REVISE followed by PASS on the same body digest keeps the finding open, writes no node.passed, and enters awaiting_human; changed-digest progress passes.

findings.title: Reducer-owned transition capability remains caller-obtainable and permits forged PASS/completion
findings.required_fix: Remove caller-obtainable authority issuance and caller-controlled review-state trust from the transition boundary. node.passed must depend on application-owned durably current independent PASS evidence; task.completed must be produced only inside current successful Completion Gate evaluation.

findings.title: WP-04 gate does not mechanically cover required authority scope stale reuse and event-type mismatch cases
findings.required_fix: Bind exact zero-write cases for missing authority, stale source snapshot, wrong task or scope, event-type mismatch and one-use token reuse.
